test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The test flight of Gaganyan was successfully carried out by the scientists of ISRO.

options.text: The test flight of Gaganyan successfully carried out the scientists of ISRO
The scientists of ISRO successfully carried out the test flight of Gaganyan.
The scientists of ISRO will successfully carry out the test flight of Gaganyan.
The scientists of ISRO are successfully carrying out the test flight of Gaganyan.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**
